rules.title: LA Council motion: report on feasibility of banning algorithmic rent-setting software
rules.requirement: A City Council motion asks the Los Angeles Housing Department to report on how many landlords use algorithm-based rent-setting software and whether the City could ban it. No ban exists yet.
rules.requirement_es: Una moción del Concejo Municipal pide al Departamento de Vivienda de Los Ángeles que informe cuántos propietarios usan programas de fijación de rentas basados en algoritmos y si la Ciudad podría prohibirlos. Todavía no existe ninguna prohibición.
rules.quoted_span: report on the number of ownership and management entities that are using algorithm-based
rules.caveat: Motion only (presented Sept 3, 2024) requesting a report on feasibility; not an adopted ordinance.

rules.title: San Francisco ban on algorithmic rent-setting tools (passing mention)
rules.requirement: San Francisco bans property owners and managers from using algorithm-based tools that recommend or set rental prices.
rules.requirement_es: San Francisco prohíbe a los propietarios y administradores usar herramientas basadas en algoritmos que recomiendan o fijan precios de alquiler.
rules.quoted_span: legislation to ban property owners and managers from using algorithm-based tools that recommend
rules.caveat: Only a passing mention in an LA motion; document says the Board of Supervisors approved the legislation in July 2024 but gives no ordinance number, effective date, or final enactment details. Citation is approximate.
